item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip0: Use to cross into the Unstable Frontier; use there to return.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip1: Cage towers loom over the wilds. Step inside a cage and it wakes.
item.unstable_frontiers.rift_shard.tip2: Lost your way? /frontier return takes you home.
item.unstable_frontiers.swarmbreaker.tip: Use to Pounce: leap forward, and land in a shockwave.
message.unstable_frontiers.tower_busy: The cage is quiet for now (too many towers are fighting on this server).
message.unstable_frontiers.tower_complet: The cage tower is broken. You take %s Cage Trophies.
message.unstable_frontiers.first_reward: Among the wreckage of your first tower: the Swarmbreaker.
message.unstable_frontiers.arrive: The Unstable Frontier. A cage tower rises %s blocks to the %s.
message.unstable_frontiers.arrive_none: The Unstable Frontier. No cage tower in sight; travel and watch the skyline.
message.unstable_frontiers.no_frontier: The frontier dimension is missing (is the data pack disabled?).
message.unstable_frontiers.return_not_he: You are not in the frontier.
message.unstable_frontiers.return_cooldo: The rift is still closing. Try again in %s s.
advancement.unstable_frontiers.root.desc: Craft an Unstable Rift Shard (amethyst, crying obsidian, an eye of ender)
advancement.unstable_frontiers.caged.des: Set foot in a cage tower. Each cage you step into wakes its floor
advancement.unstable_frontiers.trophy.de: Clear all three cages and the crown of a tower, or rob a crown vault
advancement.unstable_frontiers.swarmbrea: Win the Swarmbreaker from your first tower, or forge one from four Cage Trophies and a netherite sword
